# Kids & Teens Dental Place

> Pediatric dental practice in Houston and Pearland, TX offering comprehensive dentistry services for infants, children, and adolescents with specialized care options.

Kids & Teens Dental Place is a pediatric dentistry practice led by DDS Cecilia Carpio and DDS Alvaro Carpio, serving the Houston and Pearland, Texas areas. The practice specializes in preventive, restorative, cosmetic, and emergency dental care for children of all ages, including those with special needs.
